chooseResponse.q: What did you think of the movie?

conversation.transcript:
Student: Hey, did you see the new movie that came out last weekend?
Advisor: Yes, I did! What did you think of it?
Student: I thought it was incredible! The special effects were stunning.
Advisor: I agree! The storyline was a bit predictable, though.

questions.q: What is the student's opinion of the movie?
questions.explain: 學生對這部電影的評價是正面的，表示非常喜歡。

questions.q: What does the advisor think about the storyline?
questions.explain: 顧問認為劇情有些可預測，這是他對電影的一個看法。

talk.transcript: Today, we will discuss the concept of sustainability. Sustainability refers to meeting our own needs without compromising the ability of future generations to meet theirs. It involves three main pillars: environmental protection, social equity, and economic viability. By adopting sustainable practices, we can ensure that resources are available for future use. This includes using renewable energy, reducing waste, and supporting fair trade. Implementing these practices not only helps the planet but also fosters a better society. As we move forward, it is crucial to incorporate sustainability into our daily lives and decision-making processes.

questions.q: What does sustainability aim to achieve?
questions.explain: 可持續性旨在滿足我們的需求，同時不妨礙未來世代的需求。

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT one of the three main pillars of sustainability?
questions.explain: 技術進步不是可持續性的三大支柱之一。

questions.q: What is one example of a sustainable practice mentioned?
questions.explain: 減少浪費是講座中提到的一個可持續做法。

questions.q: Why is it important to incorporate sustainability into daily life?
options: To ensure resource availability for the future.
questions.explain: 將可持續性融入日常生活是為了確保未來資源的可用性。
